acceptance_rows: Leader reaping and an empty output selector alone never establish verified cleanup; check the owned process group independently, terminate surviving members, and verify cleanup within a bounded deadline.

Publish status=ok, reaped=true, and ownership_uncertain=false together only when command completion and cleanup verification both succeed; failed or unsupported ownership verification must fail closed.

Add fresh scenario O70 covering a successful leader that leaves a long-lived descendant with stdout and stderr redirected to DEVNULL; assert the descendant is gone before verified success, or the runner reports cleanup uncertainty and failure.

O70 also verifies bounded handling of a descendant that ignores graceful termination and preserves successful behavior for a command with no surviving descendants; fixtures clean up their processes even on assertion failure.
objective: Verify descendant cleanup independently of leader exit and output-pipe closure.
stop_condition: Print CARD_BLOCKED C9: <reason> and stop if reliable bounded ownership verification cannot be implemented within the allowed files, or any instruction conflicts. Use only read/edit/write tools, create no other files, keep each edit below 3000 characters, and finish with exactly CARD_DONE C9.
